decision_framework.fresh_cash_test: Material cash is present and fully fundable actionable lanes exist; deploy-or-explain review requires deployment into the qualified distinct exposures or an explicit reason not to deploy.
decision_framework.allocation_principle: Allocate only to distinct EU-local exposures that pass exact identity, KID/UCITS, completed-close and two-provider consensus. Do not force ticker count and do not treat donor U.S. portfolio fundability labels as EU authority.
decision_framework.cash_after_explanation: After funding one defense and one water implementation, remaining cash is retained because healthcare, semiconductors and agriculture lack two-provider consensus and grid/critical-minerals/India lack complete current exact-line evidence. No fixed cash floor is applied.

implementation_duels.winner_reason: Both exact Xetra lines have Alpha Vantage + Yahoo completed-close consensus. IQQQ wins the current implementation duel on operating scale, live history since 2007 and broad 66-holding implementation; XMLC remains a valid lower-cost accumulating alternative.
implementation_duels.alternative_strength: XMLC has lower TER (0.49%) and accumulating treatment; it remains the first implementation replacement if IQQQ execution quality deteriorates.
